column1: # The test users of docs/11 and what each one's token must hold on client cmapi-nonprod. The one source for apply-test-identities.sh,
# deploy/crc-proof.sh, deploy/tests/realm-test.py and the checks of cmapi-groups.ldif and the realm import, so none derives "expected" from what it tests.
# Fields, tab-separated: uid, uidNumber, LDAP groups, client roles. A list is comma-separated, sorted; - is none.
